instruction: I want to highlight important questions in my tutorial assessment criteria section. Please make all the question paragraphs (the ones starting with 'Do', 'Can', etc.) italic to distinguish them from the rest of the text.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making question paragraphs italic. Document has 11 question paragraphs (starting with 'Do', 'Can', 'Regarding'). Evaluator counts paragraphs where all text is italic. Expected count: 11.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator counts ALL italic paragraphs regardless of content, but instruction specifically requires question paragraphs (starting with 'Do', 'Can', etc.) to be italic

Add logic: if para.text.strip().startswith(tuple(question_starters)): then check italic status
